newsitem.title: USA: CIG says no firm gas cut despite Wyo. outage.
newsitem.headline: CIG says no firm gas cut despite Wyo. outage.

text.p: Colorado Interstate Gas Co, a unit of Coastal Corp, said Wednesday a gas compressor problem at its Rawlins station in south-central Wyoming did not result in any cuts in primary firm service.

"Basically, we're in pretty good shape. We have not curtailed any primary firm service, but we have curtailed approximately five million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of interruptible service," a company spokesman said.
He said the company still expected to be back to full service by late Friday.
On Monday, CIG declared force majeure effective Tuesday due to the compressor problem that was discovered last weekend.
The company's mainline, which has a capacity of 600 mmcfd, flows gas from production areas in Wyoming to Colorado, where it can access pipes into Texas or the Midwest.
